title: French and British interregnum in the Dutch East Indies
text: The French and British interregnum in the Dutch East Indies took place between 1806 and 1816. The First French Empire ruled between 1806 and 1811, while the British Empire took over from 1811 to 1816 and transferred its control back to the Dutch in 1816. However Java and Sumatra were only returned in July 1821.
